# Normaltown USA robots.txt
# Paste into beehiiv: Settings -> SEO -> robots.txt (custom).
# Goal: WELCOME AI answer engines so they can read and CITE Normaltown USA (GEO),
# while keeping normal search crawlers and blocking only the login page.

# --- AI answer / citation crawlers (the GEO ones you WANT reading you) ---
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot        # ChatGPT search results + citations
Allow: /

User-agent: GPTBot               # OpenAI (also trains models)
Allow: /

User-agent: PerplexityBot        # Perplexity answers + citations
Allow: /

User-agent: Google-Extended      # feeds Google AI Overviews / Gemini
Allow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot            # Anthropic / Claude
Allow: /

User-agent: Amazonbot            # Amazon / Alexa (beehiiv default BLOCKS this)
Allow: /

User-agent: CCBot                # Common Crawl (feeds many AI datasets)
Allow: /

# --- Everyone else (normal search engines included) ---
User-agent: *
Allow: /
Disallow: /login

Sitemap: https://www.normaltownusa.com/sitemap.xml
